titulo: Microsoft Edge is about to lock out older ad blockers, just like Chrome did
cuerpo: Microsoft Edge is ending support for the Manifest V2 extensions platform, which will cut off the uBlock Origin adblocker and others like it, just like Google Chrome did earlier this year.
